title: Michelle L. Christian (governance advisory principal; AI governance & stewardship) — Incorruptible 'is literally a blueprint for how to make it happen'
summary: Michelle L. Christian — governance advisory principal focused on AI governance and stewardship — endorses Incorruptible from inside the corporate-governance profession. Frames Eric's approach as the alternative to reform: designing systems that are as close as possible to incorruptible from the start.
blockquote: I have long suspected that our efforts are better put into creating systems that are as close as possible to being incorruptible rather than trying to reform existing systems. "Incorruptible" is literally a blueprint for how to make it happen.
attribution_title: Governance advisory principal · AI governance & stewardship
